paragraphs.zh: 其中，R为三氟乙基时为环磺酮中间体，R为2-四氢呋喃甲基时为呋喃磺草酮中间体。
paragraphs.en: Wherein, when R is trifluoroethyl the compound is an intermediate of tembotrione, and when R is 2-tetrahydrofurylmethyl it is an intermediate of tefuryltrione.
paragraphs.notes: 环磺酮 and 呋喃磺草酮 are rendered as tembotrione and tefuryltrione respectively; the Chinese names are the authoritative form and the identification of the active ingredients is mine, not the patent's.

paragraphs.zh: 虽然如上方法可以得到目标化合物，但所得产品纯度较差，杂质2-氯-3-甲氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸占比较大。该杂质的占比因底物不同有较大区别，当R为三氟乙基时该杂质归一比约3～5％，R为2-四氢呋喃甲基时该杂质归一比可达8～12％。该杂质因碱性环境中原料中的酯碱断裂或发生酯交换而副产甲醇，甲醇进一步与原料中的苄溴基团反应而产生，该杂质因结构、性质与化目标化合物较为相似，不易去除，带入后续反应中衍生出了对应的新杂质，最终严重影响到环磺酮和呋喃磺草酮原药的品质。
paragraphs.en: Although the target compound can be obtained by the above method, the purity of the product obtained is rather poor, and the impurity 2-chloro-3-methoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid accounts for a relatively large proportion. The proportion of this impurity differs considerably with the substrate: when R is trifluoroethyl the normalised proportion of this impurity is about 3 to 5％, and when R is 2-tetrahydrofurylmethyl the normalised proportion can reach 8 to 12％. This impurity arises because, in the basic environment, the ester in the starting material undergoes base cleavage or transesterification and gives methanol as a byproduct, and the methanol reacts further with the benzyl bromide group of the starting material. Because this impurity is fairly similar in structure and properties to the target compound, it is not easily removed; carried into the subsequent reaction it gives rise to corresponding new impurities, and it ultimately seriously affects the quality of the tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.
paragraphs.notes: Printed as 与化目标化合物较为相似; the character 化 before 目标化合物 appears to be a printing error in the original and is transcribed as printed, not corrected. 酯碱断裂 is also transcribed as printed (literally 'ester base cleavage'). The ranges use the full-width wave dash ～ and the full-width percent sign ％ as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 随着我国农药管理体系的完善，以及农药管理体系与国际接轨，对农药产品品质提出了更高的要求，对于农药杂质的管理也出台了相关的法令法规，当下杂质产生机理的研究和控制手段的研究尤为重要。为了得到高品质的环磺酮和呋喃磺草酮原药，急需一种新的2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法，以减少杂质的含量，提高目标产物的纯度。
paragraphs.en: With the improvement of China's pesticide administration system, and with that system falling into line with international practice, higher requirements have been placed on the quality of pesticide products, and relevant decrees and regulations have also been issued for the management of pesticide impurities, so that research into the mechanism by which impurities form and into the means of controlling them is at present especially important. In order to obtain high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material, a new process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid is urgently needed, so as to reduce the impurity content and raise the purity of the target product.

paragraphs.notes: Bold section heading printed between [0011] and [0012]. It carries no paragraph marker.

paragraphs.zh: 为解决上述技术问题，本发明提供了一种2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法，有效规避了杂质2-氯-3-甲氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的产生，为后续制备高品质环磺酮和呋喃磺草酮原药提供了保障。
paragraphs.en: To solve the above technical problem, the present invention provides a process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid which effectively avoids the formation of the impurity 2-chloro-3-methoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, and thereby provides assurance for the subsequent preparation of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.

paragraphs.zh: 为达此目的，本发明采用如下技术方案：
paragraphs.en: To achieve this object, the present invention adopts the following technical scheme:

paragraphs.zh: 一种2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法，包括步骤如下：
paragraphs.en: A process for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, comprising the following steps:

paragraphs.zh: (1)原料2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯在碱性物质存在下于三级醇溶剂中发生酯解反应得到2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐；
paragraphs.en: (1) the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance, giving a 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt;
paragraphs.notes: 三级醇 is translated literally as tertiary alcohol. 酯解反应 is translated literally as ester cleavage reaction; the Chinese does not specify hydrolysis as opposed to alcoholysis. 苯甲酸盐 is a benzoate salt and the counter-ion is only given as M in the scheme at [0017].

paragraphs.en: The reaction process described in this step can be represented by the following reaction equation:

paragraphs.en: In the formula M represents an alkali metal.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。
paragraphs.en: (2) the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or else the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid.

substituents: C(=O)OH (carboxylic acid, drawn HO-C(=O)) at C1

drawings.notes: Ring numbering is read off the drawing: the carbon bearing the ester carbonyl is taken as C1, and Cl, CH2Br/CH2OR and SO2CH3 sit on the three consecutive carbons going clockwise from it (C2, C3, C4), the remaining two ring positions carrying no substituent. Both structures 2 and 3 carry a generic R on the ether oxygen, so no SMILES and no name is given for them; [0009] states that R is trifluoroethyl or 2-tetrahydrofurylmethyl but the drawing itself does not determine R. On the second arrow the two reagent labels are a numbered sequence, and 1) 碱 is printed above the arrow line and 2) 酸 below it; they are recorded in the positions as drawn, but the vertical positions here encode step order rather than the usual above/below reagent distinction. This scheme sits in the background discussion: [0010] immediately after it says 虽然如上方法 (although the above method) and criticises the purity it gives, so it is the prior art route, not the invention's.

substituents: C(=O)O-M (carboxylate salt, drawn MO-C(=O)) at C1

discrepancies.what: The prose for step (1) names a tertiary alcohol solvent, but the scheme drawn at [0017] writes only the base on the arrow and no solvent.

discrepancies.text_says: [0015] 在碱性物质存在下于三级醇溶剂中发生酯解反应, that is, ester cleavage in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance

discrepancies.what: The prior art scheme at [0008] shows the alkylation with ROH happening on the methyl ester and the ester being cleaved only afterwards, whereas the invention described in the prose reverses the order, cleaving the ester first and then alkylating.
discrepancies.drawing_says: ester, then ROH/base to the ether, then 1) base 2) acid to the acid
discrepancies.text_says: [0015] and [0019]: ester cleavage to the benzoate salt first, then reaction of that salt with an alcohol or with an alkali metal alkoxide
